name: Word ring
what: One word, many times, moving along a shape: copies appear around a spinning pinwheel; words run along a winding ribbon; or a wavy band of stacked words scrolls up.

learned_from.what: the word repeated around a spinning ring that spirals in
words running along a winding ribbon
a wavy band of stacked words scrolling up

motion: copies back.out 12 f, 4 f apart, the ring turns 60 degrees a second; the ribbon draws 30 f and the words run; the wave lines swing 26 f a side
